course.title: Kubernetes — Complete Deep DevOps Course
course.description: A Kubernetes-specific, beginner-to-advanced course focused on real development and production workflows, with detailed concepts, practicals, dedicated tasks, security, troubleshooting and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn this technology properly; no fixed cross-tool template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Understand Kubernetes from fundamentals to production usage.
Implement a production-style learning platform deployment.

modules.title: Kubernetes Foundations
modules.description: Clusters, control plane, nodes, workloads and declarative infrastructure.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Foundations
lessons.description: Clusters, control plane, nodes, workloads and declarative infrastructure.
learningObjectives: Apply Kubernetes in a real deployment workflow.
Explain security, scaling and failure considerations.

notes.text: Clusters, control plane, nodes, workloads and declarative infrastructure.

Understand kubernetes foundations as an engineering problem first and a tool feature second. The student should know what problem it solves, what happens behind the scenes at a high level, how it fits into a real deployment, and what can go wrong.

Kubernetes Foundations becomes important when a learning platform moves from local development toward repeatable, secure and scalable delivery. The goal is to understand the operational trade-offs, not merely memorize commands.

notes.caption: Add a clear architecture/flow diagram explaining Kubernetes Foundations visually.

items: Understand the desired state or workflow.
Identify the components and their relationships.
Understand failure, recovery and rollback behavior.

notes.code:

Example: SET course:python:progress 75 EX 300

items: Copying commands without understanding what they change.
